senses.gloss:
Kīlakakavaca
on Devī; source not indicated. RASB. VIII. B. 6653.

Kīlakavarṣapañcāṅga
almanac for the year Kīlaka. Adyar II. p. 66b (2 mss.). TA. 410-427.

Kīlakavivaraṇa
a C. on Devīkīlaka stotra noted below ? by Śitikaṇṭha. BORI. 444 of 1875-76. Report XXIX.

Kīlakastotra
on Devī; source not indicated. Adyar I. p. 227a. Allahabad 105. 112. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 18. Mysore I. p. 199. RASB. VIII. A. 6412. 6414. Śg. II. 236. Taylor I. 241 (K. stuti). TD. 19585.
--C. Vivaraṇa by Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa. Stein 228.

Kīlakastotra
in 10-14 verses; attached to the Devīmāhātmya. In some mss. Śiva is said to be the speaker an. in one Viṣṇu; in one Svāyambhuvāgama is given a. source.
Br. Mus. 118A. 122. 123A. CPB. 913. IO. 3558-63. 6783-90 (6786 alone mentions Śiva a. speaker an. source a. Svāyambhuvāgama; 6787 wrongly called Argalā; 6790 gives Viṣṇu a. speaker). 6797-98. Oxf. II. 1473 (3). 1474 (3). Petrograd 14C. Stein 231. Whish 42.
Pt.. with edns. of Devīmāhātmya, also in other collections: Āvaśyakanitya- [Page171-b] karma, p.. 19-20, Calcutta, 1864; in Nityakarmapaddhati, Patna, 1916; in Caturdas'aratna Durgākavaca p.. 57-66; with Nepali C., Benares, 1912. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 974 an. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p.. 244. 629. 736. 1350. 1351.
--C. by Nāgoji Bhaṭṭa. IO. 3568 (part of his C. on Devīmāhātmya).

Kīlanotkīlanastotra
tantra. spoken by God Śiva. CPB. 914.

Kīleśvarastotra
from Svāyambhuvapurāṇa. by Kulika Nāgarāja. IO. 7119 (13). C.. IO. 6786, Kīlakastotra from Svāyambhuvāgama.
